title: Arzela-Ascoli compact closure in the uniform metric
statement: Let $X$ be a compact topological space, let $(Y,d)$ be a metric space, and let $Q\subseteq Y$ be compact with its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology]. Write $C_b(X,Y)$ for bounded continuous maps, with uniform metric $d_\infty(f,g)=\sup_{x\in X}d(f(x),g(x))$ (zero if $X$ is empty). Let $\mathcal A\subseteq C_b(X,Y)$ and assume $f(x)\in Q$ for all $f\in\mathcal A$ and $x\in X$. Assume equicontinuity: for each $x\in X$ and $\epsilon>0$, some open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ [def-kun-open-neighbourhood] satisfies $d(f(y),f(x))<\epsilon$ for every $f\in\mathcal A$ and $y\in U$. Then the closure of $\mathcal A$ in $C_b(X,Y)$ is compact.
